name: OP Adversarial Pressure MCP
description: A remote MCP server offering eight bounded adversarial checks that an AI assistant can invoke during a task and evaluate.

tools.name: stress_structure
tools.purpose: Tests whether the supplied material supports a direct challenge to a stated link between a mechanism and its intended outcome.

tools.name: sparring_pressure
tools.purpose: The assistant picks a point in an early idea and an angle of attack. The model proposes a hypothetical change and its direct effect.

tools.name: sparring_scan
tools.purpose: Starting with an early idea and its exact goal, the model identifies one load-bearing mechanism and applies pressure without replacing the idea.

tools.name: premortem_trace
tools.purpose: Follows one failure condition already present in a plan through a mechanism to a specified failed outcome.

tools.name: premortem_scan
tools.purpose: Works backward from one failed goal to suggest a possible initiating cause and causal path through the supplied plan.

tools.name: abuse_path
tools.purpose: Explores a hypothetical path from stated access through a named control to the outcome that control protects. No attack is performed.

tools.name: adversarial_review
tools.purpose: Looks for a structural weakness in one supplied artifact and suggests a minimal correction. The assistant checks whether it holds.

tools.name: redteam_experiment
tools.purpose: Designs one experiment with observable results using only the actions expressly allowed. The tool does not execute it.
